cross_provision_findings.headline: Relief: Lease Term & Renewal substance found in Section 1.2
cross_provision_findings.detail: Article 1 and 2 expressly define initial term, commencement and expiration dates.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Relief: Quiet Enjoyment substance found in Section 18.1
cross_provision_findings.detail: Quiet enjoyment covenant is expressly granted.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no specification of payment methods or tenant-favorable payment terms.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has detailed rent payment and late-charge machinery; tenant lacks specification of compliant payment methods.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no cap protection against higher increases.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord receives fixed 3% escalations; tenant has no cap protection against higher increases.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has limited setoff rights only after landlord default.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord controls deposit application and return; tenant has only limited post-default setoff rights.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no continuous operation or co-tenancy protections.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord restricts tenant to narrow permitted use; tenant has no continuous-operation or co-tenancy protections.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no defined response times for landlord repairs.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord maintains structure without defined timelines; tenant has no enforceable response-time standards for repairs.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no cap on annual CAM increases.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord recovers all CAM with tenant audit rights only; tenant has no cap on annual CAM increases.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no explicit certificate delivery timeline.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord requires extensive insurance; tenant has no explicit certificate delivery timeline.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no change of control relief or profit sharing.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord controls all assignments with recapture; tenant has no change-of-control relief or profit sharing.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant owns no improvements at end and has no removal standards.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord approves alterations with no contribution; tenant owns no improvements at end and lacks removal standards.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no acceleration protection or lender cure rights.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has termination, re-entry and deficiency remedies; tenant has no acceleration protection or lender cure rights.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no rent abatement or exit right after extended force majeure.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Both parties receive time extensions but tenant has no rent abatement or exit right after extended force majeure.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no pylon rights or protection from landlord removal.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord controls signage approval and removal; tenant has no pylon rights or protection from removal.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no protection against parking area changes or visitor access.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord maintains parking via CAM; tenant has no protection against parking-area changes.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no protection from consequential damages claims.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord can charge 150% rent and terminate at sufferance; tenant has no protection from consequential-damages claims.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant bears all upgrade costs without allocation.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord provides initial capacity; tenant bears all upgrade costs without allocation.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Landlord has no remedies defined for violation.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Tenant receives limited exclusivity with carve-out; landlord has no defined remedies for violation.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant's guarantor has no cap or release provisions.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord receives full unconditional guaranty; tenant's guarantor has no cap or release provisions.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must execute documents on demand with no timing protections.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord requires subordination with best-efforts non-disturbance; tenant must execute documents on demand without timing protections.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no claim to insurance proceeds on termination.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Both parties can terminate; tenant has no claim to insurance proceeds on termination.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no restoration obligation or right after partial taking.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Both parties can terminate; tenant has no restoration obligation or right after partial taking.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has only security deposit setoff after 30-day notice.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has full default remedies in Article 17; tenant has only security-deposit setoff after 30-day notice.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no ADA allocation or grandfathering protection.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord responsible for structure; tenant has no ADA allocation or grandfathering protection.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no right to representative or frequency limits.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has 48-hour notice entry for multiple purposes; tenant has no representative or frequency limits.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no form protection or request frequency limit.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Both parties can request estoppels with 15-day deadline; tenant has no form protection or request-frequency limit.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no testing rights or protection from pre-existing conditions.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord prohibits tenant hazardous materials with remediation duty; tenant has no testing rights or pre-existing-condition protection.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Automatic subordination without guaranteed non-disturbance for future lenders exposes tenant to loss of possession on foreclosure.
Article 17 supplies landlord with full default-remedy machinery; tenant must assemble remedies piecemeal from isolated clauses with no parallel default article.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Article 17 vs. Section 5.1 and Articles 13/24 | Article 17 vs. Sections 5.1, 24.11 and 3.1

cross_provision_findings.headline: Audit right exists but Section 3.1 bars offset, withholding or self-help, leaving only litigation or 60-day termination path.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Section 3.4 vs. Sections 3.1, 3.3(b) and 5.1

cross_provision_findings.headline: Future-lender SNDA obligation is only commercially reasonable efforts; quiet enjoyment is expressly subject to superior interests.
Structural repair obligation can be suspended indefinitely by force majeure while no abatement or self-help right exists and rent remains due.
Regulatory change impairing permitted use triggers no rent relief or termination right and exclusivity contains material carve-outs.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Sections 4.1, 4.2 and 24.14
